To the attest team · re: HANGS Construction Services LLC · in reply to the audit inquiry of September 28, 2026
At our client’s request we describe below the pending or threatened litigation, claims and assessments on which we have been
engaged and to which we have devoted substantive attention on its behalf. This response is limited by our client’s instructions
and the ABA Statement of Policy, and speaks as of its date.
Matter 1: Corliss Medical Group PLLC: suit to foreclose HCS’s lien for the $186,935.00 final billing
After mediation on October 6, 2026, the parties signed a settlement: Corliss pays $110,000.00 by October 30, 2026 in full settlement
of the $186,935.00 billed; HCS releases its lien and dismisses the suit on payment. The settlement agreement is attached.
Matter 2: Brindlewood School District No. 14: liquidated damages of $41,250.00 under section 8.3
HCS asked on July 20, 2026 for a 12-day extension. The district denied it on September 15, 2026. On our advice HCS will not
Matter 3: HCS’s backcharge claim against Harrowgate Precast Inc. for the Tideflats panels
A claim by our client, not against it. We cannot predict its outcome or amount.
Unasserted claims: we have not been asked to advise on, and are not aware of, any unasserted claim or assessment that is
probable of assertion. No other pending or threatened litigation.
Celeste Quist, Partner, Pellham & Quist LLP
